name: cobrowser
description: Stable Playwright-based browser operation for Codex using plugin-managed Chrome profiles.

interface.shortDescription: Operate real Chrome sessions from Codex
interface.longDescription: CoBrowser gives Codex a stable browser operation layer built on Playwright persistent Chrome contexts. It manages isolated browser profiles, standard page actions, screenshots, downloads, and diagnostics without relying on the Codex Chrome extension.
defaultPrompt: Use CoBrowser headed to inspect this page.
Use CoBrowser headless to read this URL.
Use CoBrowser headed and take a screenshot.
